description: Places the order prepare_checkout summarised, after the customer has seen that summary and said yes. Pass its confirmation_token and a new UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with the same key returns the same order and never places a second. Printdash re-prices every line and refuses a price that moved since the review (then call prepare_checkout again). Payment never happens here: a card order comes back with payment_url, the order page on printdash.io where the customer pays; an on-account order needs no payment; a held order waits for a Team owner. Never call it without the customer's agreement. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID you generate for this order; reuse it only to retry the same one.

name: place_order
title: Place the prepared order
